module Shapes
  WORDS = %w(circle square triangle)
  PATTERN = %r{^[a-z]+$}

  def self.safe_divide(a, b)
    begin
      a / b
    rescue ZeroDivisionError
      0
    ensure
      log_call
    end
  end

  def self.log_call
    puts %q{called}
  end
end

def with_block
  [1, 2, 3].each do |n|
    puts n
  end
end

def with_brace_block
  [1, 2, 3].each { |n| puts n }
end
